eoe.text: Taro-duend is the Kav strike town where Sami lands the Seriema in a slag pool, and Kav rescue crews rush the ship and take the comatose Kav soldiers away in ambulances.

The political postilion sees through Sami's act and says he saw the hotcell cask stamped for Sigma's Reach, and when a Sunstar Free Company ship demands the escaped spies, he refuses to hand Sami over.

When Vondam asks Haliya whether she could destroy all Taro-duend, she refuses to kill a settlement of defenseless innocents, and the Free Company sweeps the town with drones and infantry while the Kav resist by sabotage and obstruction.

Vondam announces protocol seven, and the Sundog lasers every heat source in Taro-duend, sets houses on fire after the fleeing Kav gather inside and ignites its main fusion engine over the town, killing the survivors with radiation and fire.
